selectionGroups.name: root-operator-over-fraction-batch
selectionGroups.evidence: The 12-object batch deadlocks in WholeDocument mode and completes all 12 editable objects in 34.4 seconds with ChunkSize 1.
selectionGroups.reason: Isolate adjacent root, operator-name, and infix-over templates from MathType 7.11 cross-object formatter state.

selectionGroups.name: over-under-arrow-batch
selectionGroups.evidence: Both complex arrow objects format individually and the original batch completes in 8.3 seconds with ChunkSize 1, while WholeDocument deadlocks.
selectionGroups.reason: Isolate adjacent over/under and labeled-arrow template state in MathType 7.11.

selectionGroups.name: sideset-labeled-arrow-batch
selectionGroups.evidence: Both objects format individually and the original batch completes in 8.3 seconds with ChunkSize 1, while WholeDocument deadlocks.
selectionGroups.reason: Isolate sideset pre/post scripts from the following labeled-arrow template state.

shardGroups.name: special-symbol-greek-pair
shardGroups.evidence: The special-symbol and uppercase-Greek pair deadlocks in WholeDocument mode and on its first Selection chunk after standard dynamic font binding is applied.
shardGroups.reason: Format the two font-definition-heavy objects in isolated Word and PowerShell processes, then merge them in source order.

shardGroups.name: mbox-size-fence-pair
shardGroups.evidence: The mbox size/script object completes individually in 12.6 seconds, while its adjacent fence batch deadlocks in WholeDocument mode.
shardGroups.reason: Isolate mbox size state from the following explicit fence object.

shardGroups.name: left-aligned-single-column-arrays
shardGroups.evidence: The two-object batch remained blocked for more than four minutes after both objects were regenerated with the pinned MathType matrix alignment header.
shardGroups.reason: Format each left-aligned single-column matrix in an independent Word and MathType process to prevent cross-object matrix state deadlock.

shardGroups.name: partitioned-array-pair
shardGroups.evidence: The two-object array batch remained in MTCommand_FormatEqns for more than one minute after regeneration with desktop matrix headers.
shardGroups.reason: Refresh each partitioned array and its WMF in a separate Word and MathType process.

shardGroups.name: fenced-matrix-batch
shardGroups.evidence: These four adjacent formulas all contain matrix records and follow the same cross-object formatter state path that blocked the preceding regenerated array batches.
shardGroups.reason: Isolate each fenced matrix so its alignment state and WMF are rebuilt in a fresh desktop MathType process.

shardGroups.name: bracketed-matrix-pair
shardGroups.evidence: The adjacent row and column bmatrix objects share the matrix formatter state implicated by the preceding blocked batches.
shardGroups.reason: Format the row and column matrices independently to prevent shape-state carryover.

shardGroups.name: equivalent-radical-delimiter-forms
shardGroups.evidence: The radical objects format individually, but WholeDocument and repeated Selection formatting deadlock when adjacent radical forms share one Word document.
shardGroups.reason: Format each editable OLE in a one-object DOCX and merge the formatted objects back in source order.

shardGroups.name: empty-root-stackrel-pair
shardGroups.evidence: Both project-generated editable OLE objects complete individually in 13.8 and 10.8 seconds, while WholeDocument and repeated Selection formatting deadlock for the adjacent pair.
shardGroups.reason: Format the empty radical and following stackrel object in separate one-object DOCX files, then merge them in source order.

shardGroups.name: text-inline-math-pair
shardGroups.evidence: The text and nested-inline-math objects complete individually in 15.2 and 10.8 seconds, while WholeDocument formatting deadlocks for the adjacent pair.
shardGroups.reason: Isolate MathType text-mode formatter state in one-object DOCX files and merge the editable objects in source order.

shardGroups.name: text-mode-corpus-batch
shardGroups.evidence: The four-object text batch deadlocks in WholeDocument mode and on its first Selection chunk; one-object shards provide independent completion reports before merge.
shardGroups.reason: Isolate long text, escaped text symbols, and text subscripts from cross-object MathType formatter state.

shardGroups.name: text-font-fraction-batch
shardGroups.evidence: The adjacent textrm, text fraction, and typewriter objects deadlock in WholeDocument mode; each one-object shard must complete before merge.
shardGroups.reason: Isolate text font and fraction state transitions in separate Word documents.

shardGroups.name: underbrace-underset-pair
shardGroups.evidence: The adjacent underbrace and underset objects deadlock in WholeDocument mode; each one-object shard must complete before merge.
shardGroups.reason: Isolate lower annotation template state between the two editable objects.

shardGroups.name: labeled-arrow-final-batch
shardGroups.evidence: The final labeled-arrow batch deadlocks in WholeDocument mode and on its first Selection chunk; each one-object shard must complete before merge.
shardGroups.reason: Isolate repeated and extended labeled-arrow template state in separate Word documents.

shardGroups.name: layout-sensitive-standard-preferences
shardGroups.evidence: A one-object indexed-root run with the pinned 12pt clipboard preference object reached SSIM=1.0 and foreground IoU=1.0, while the same normalized MTEF formatted as the third object retained the preceding objects' layout state.
shardGroups.reason: Isolate fraction, limit, and indexed-root families whose WMF layout inherits cross-object MathType formatter state.

limitations.evidence: The one-object DOCX generated by MathType TeXToggle also times out after 120 seconds in MTCommand_FormatEqns.
limitations.reason: MathType 7.11 Format Equations cannot complete for its own editable reference object.
